description: Mairie de Montluel - Borne de recharge pour is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mairie de Montluel (IRVE). The town hall of Montluel provides charging stations for electric vehicles. This game gathers the list of functional charging stations for electric vehicles in the municipality of Montluel. Coverage: Mairie de Montluel (IRVE). The portal shows the English title as "Mayor of Montluel — Charging terminal for electric vehicles" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Mairie de Montluel (IRVE). Its keywords include ain, irve, mobilite-electrique, amenagement-urbain. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
